metadata.description: Curated Claude Code plugins that ship quality. sniff walks your running app in a real browser and tells you what is actually broken, with the steps to reproduce it. ui-ux-suite is ESLint for design: the exact line, the measured wrong value, the exact fix. recap-studio turns a topic or a coding session into one offline HTML explainer you can double-click. aws-cost-audit reads your live AWS account read-only and checks every price against live AWS pricing. goalify writes the brief and the condition for a big task a fresh session runs on its own. humanizer names 55 AI writing habits and rewrites text in the voice you pick. loopify writes the brief and the line that keep a repeating job running on Claude Code's built-in /loop. secure-my-app finds what a stranger can take from your app, then proves each fix shut with the same command that found it. contextify writes short agent instructions and optional architecture/workflow docs, then uses installed Git hooks to check drift at commit and push without a model. The tool plugins are dual-mode (a Claude Code plugin or a standalone MCP server); aws-cost-audit, goalify, humanizer, loopify, secure-my-app and contextify are Claude Code skills (no MCP server).

plugins.name: sniff
plugins.description: Autonomous QA scanner via sniff-qa: walks your running app in a real browser and reports real bugs (broken pages/links, console/network errors, broken forms, state-loss, empty/placeholder data, bad loading/error states, responsive + a11y) with reproduction proof, severity, confidence, and a fix. No API key.

plugins.name: ui-ux-suite
plugins.description: Design audit tool. Scores projects across 12 dimensions: color, typography, accessibility, layout, and more. WCAG, APCA, OKLCH color science. Zero dependencies.

plugins.name: recap-studio
plugins.description: Turn a topic or a coding session into one dark-mode HTML explainer you double-click and read offline in about five minutes.

plugins.name: aws-cost-audit
plugins.description: Audit a live AWS account end-to-end: attribute every dollar, find idle/orphaned resources, rightsize, check Savings Plans/RI coverage, and produce an evidence-backed savings plan with confidence levels and reversible, gated actions. Verifies prices live; hardcodes none.

plugins.name: goalify
plugins.description: Give your AI a big job and get proof it is done. Writes the brief and the /goal condition for Claude Code and Codex.

plugins.name: humanizer
plugins.description: Detects 55 AI writing patterns and rewrites text in five voice profiles so it reads like a specific human wrote it, with an optional 0-100 AI-tell score. Use when text sounds AI-generated or like a chatbot, when preparing a blog post, README, or LinkedIn post for publication, when auditing prose for AI tells, or when editing a Markdown file in place. Triggers on phrases like "humanize this", "make this sound less AI", "make this sound human", "remove AI tells", "does this read like ChatGPT", and "rewrite so it does not sound AI-generated". Pure Markdown, zero dependencies, no network calls.

plugins.name: loopify
plugins.description: Hand Claude a job that repeats. Come back to a log of what every tick did, not a loop you have to babysit.

plugins.name: secure-my-app
plugins.description: Find what a stranger can take from your app. Then close it and prove it closed.

plugins.name: contextify
plugins.description: Tell every coding agent how your repo works. Then prove it is still true.
